verdict.rationale: Blaxel ships a CLI and SDKs, so whether users can opt out of telemetry or usage tracking is a fair question for this product. Nothing in the evidence pack mentions telemetry, analytics collection, or an opt-out setting or environment variable. The proxy, firewall and regional-pinning features control sandbox traffic and where workloads run, not the vendor's own usage tracking, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can opt out of telemetry and usage tracking
